Container.Name: reclaimspace
Container.Overview:
Find Plex movies and TV episodes with duplicate files on disk. Reclaimspace keeps the file Radarr or Sonarr manages and **quarantines** the rest (never deleted).
**Web UI** on port 8777: setup wizard, dry-run scans, sortable/filterable reports, quarantine with manifests, restore preview, and an Appdata page for leftover folders.
Container.Description:
Reclaimspace finds duplicate Plex movies and TV episodes, keeps the file Radarr or Sonarr manages, and **quarantines** the rest. Nothing is deleted—files move to a timestamped folder with a rollback manifest.
**First run** 1. Open the Web UI at port **8777** (link on the Docker tab). 2. Complete the **setup wizard**, or open **Configuration** at `/config` if you already have settings. 3. Confirm container paths: Movies `/media/movies`, TV `/media/tv`, Quarantine `/quarantine` (must match your volume mappings). 4. Run a **movies dry run**, review the sortable report grid, then **quarantine** when ready. 5. For leftover appdata folders, open **/appdata**. Mount Appdata at `/appdata` and Code at `/code`. Create an Unraid API key with only `DOCKER:READ_ANY`. Do not mount the Docker socket. Media still never deletes files. Appdata Delete and Purge are permanent and ask you to confirm each folder.
**Requirements:** Plex plus Radarr (movies) and/or Sonarr (TV) on your network. The UI has no built-in login—use on a trusted LAN or behind an authenticated reverse proxy.
**Support:** [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/romwil/reclaimspace/issues)
**Documentation:** [README](https://github.com/romwil/reclaimspace) · [Docker / Unraid guide](https://github.com/romwil/reclaimspace/blob/main/docs/DOCKER.md) · [Web UI](https://github.com/romwil/reclaimspace/blob/main/docs/WEB_UI.md)

Config.Name: Movies library
Config.Description: Host movie library (set Movies root to /media/movies in Configuration)

Config.Name: TV library
Config.Description: Host TV library (set TV root to /media/tv in Configuration)

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Host appdata share (set Appdata root to /appdata in Configuration)

Config.Name: Code
Config.Description: Workspace destination (set Code root to /code in Configuration)

Config.Name: PLEX_URL
Config.Description: Optional seed: Plex URL (also editable in web UI)

Config.Name: APPDATA_HOST_PREFIXES
Config.Description: Host paths Docker reports for the appdata share, separated by semicolons

Config.Name: CODE_ROOT
Config.Description: Code workspace root inside the container

Config.Name: UNRAID_API_KEY
Config.Description: Optional seed: Unraid API key with DOCKER:READ_ANY (also editable in Configuration)

Config.Name: DOCKER_SOCKET
Config.Description: Optional Docker socket path inside the container. Leave empty to disable. Do not mount docker.sock unless you accept full Docker API access.
